findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is absent, defaulting to false), so the same key material protects the audit bucket indefinitely and any compromise or cryptoperiod exposure persists. AWS requires annual rotation for best practice. Additionally, no key policy is defined, so the key relies on the default policy which grants full control to the account root, and the resource lacks any policy restricting usage to the audit bucket principal.
